title: Exotic Unit Groups of Sylvester Rank Completions
summary: Let \(R\) be any unital ring equipped with a Sylvester matrix rank function, and let \(Q\) be the rank completion of the matrix system defined by block-diagonal embeddings along a factor sequence. We prove that both \(\GL(Q)\) and \((Q,+)\) are exotic: every strongly continuous unitary representation is trivial. We also prove that \(\GL(Q)\) is Bourbaki bounded and admits no nonzero escape function. For every \(\varepsilon>0\), let \(B_\varepsilon\) be the open ball centered at the identity.
